name: Thermoeye OCTA vessel segmentation baseline
scope: Vessel segmentation only; not AD/MCI classification or diagnosis
runtime_normalization: Pillow L, bilinear resize to 256x256, divide by 255; unsigned 16-bit inputs first use fixed /65535 scaling then quantize to 8-bit
failure_behavior: analysis_status unavailable, engine none and null measurements; never automatic heuristic fallback

measurement_definitions.vessel_density: Vessel pixels / all pixels in the nearest-neighbour resized source-dimension mask * 100
measurement_definitions.faz_risk_proxy: Non-vessel fraction in the central 30% rectangle * 100; not anatomical FAZ area or disease risk
measurement_definitions.perfusion_density: Unavailable (null); no calibrated perfusion measurement is implemented

runtime_output: sigmoid(logits) thresholded at 0.5; nearest-neighbour resize to source dimensions
note: Artifact exported from the completed checkpoint; independent clinical validation is required.
